[Intro]
[Bb5]

[Verse1]
[Bb5]Fly their flags upside down Then watch the
sky come falling in
And ranks will
swell to quell

[Chorus]
[Db5]These sepa-
ratists And our i-
dentity crisis This great i-
dentity crisis

[Bridge]
[Bb5]

[Verse 2]
[Bb5]Traitor to 'my people' No, you're a
traitor to yourself
Enslaved by
hierarchy

[Chorus]
[Db5]Demanding
dues Through this i-
dentity crisis This clear i-
dentity crisis

[Bridge]
[Bb5]
Going down on one knee

[Breakdown]
[Ab5]To bear the
load of some inglorious burden
Acting accordingly
hastens death to the individual
Going down on one knee

[Bridge]
[Bb5]
Traitor to yourself

[Verse3]
[Bb5]You roam in packs Smash the fringes to re-
mind the nationled

[Chorus]
[Db5]Going down on one
knee This clear i-
dentity crisis This clear i-
dentity crisis

[Bridge]
[Bb5]
Going down on one knee

[Outro]
[Bb5]You're a traitor to yourself
Going down on one knee
To bear the load of some in-
glorious burden
title: Identity crisis
tuning: D G C F A D
